thread:
jamie: Heads-up — seeing a short burst of 5xx from EU hosted inference starting ~09:12 UTC. Multiple customers reported streaming timeouts and whole-request 502/504. Sentry group: https://sentry.prod/redwood/issue/5234 :eyes:

devon: On it. Any quick traces or example request IDs?

jamie:  req ids: r-0a12b3, r-0a12b9, r-0a12c0. Initial glance shows proxy upstream timeouts around 30s.

ops-bot: ALERT: eu-west-1 hosted-inference cluster - increased 5xx rate (p95 errors > 3% for 10m). Triggered at 09:14 UTC. Related events: autoscaler-failure(09:13), kv-cache-lag(09:12).

lina: I started a quick repro with a heavy-seq payload. Repro curl below — showed a consistent timeout within 20-35s for large inputs.

lina: ```bash
curl -X POST "https://api.redwood-hosted.eu/v1/generate" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"gptx-8b","input":"long long prompt...","max_tokens":1024}'
```

lina: Logs show this pattern:
```
proxy: upstream timeout after 30s
worker-23: kvcache miss, queue length=420
worker-23: rejected conn: max inflight reached
```

ryan: We merged the routing change (canary) at 08:58 UTC that pins some requests to the new pool. Noticed higher queueing in canary pool at ~09:10. Rolling back the canary now. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

devon: I see the autoscaler failed to spin additional GPUs — k8s HPA saw CPU spike but pod crashlooped on image pull timeout. Investigating image pull backend logs.

jamie: Customer impact: two enterprise accounts reported request timeouts and escalated to support. Support ticket ids: S-9871, S-9874. Notified account teams.

ops-bot: REMINDER: Incident channel created for triage. War-room link: https://call.redwood/warroom/1712346789

sara: Quick mitigation plan: 1) rollback canary (ryan) — in progress. 2) increase proxy upstream timeout to 60s for EU (devon) — can patch and deploy. 3) add temporary burst capacity: scale dedicated pool +2 (ops) — request submitted. 4) add tight alert on kv-cache queue length (lina).

sara: Owners + ETA: ryan -> revert canary (done @09:22), devon -> patch timeout + deploy (ETA 30m), lina -> repro script & kvcache metrics (ETA 1h), sara -> postmortem + customer comms (draft by EOD).

ryan: Revert completed and traffic gradually shifting back to stable pool. Early signs: p50 latency down, p95 still elevated. :thumbsup:

devon: Pushed proxy timeout patch to canary (staged). Doing canary roll; if green will promote. Will also add retry logic for failed pulls.

lina: Repro script saved at gist: https://gist.github.com/lina/hosted-5xx-repro. Includes sample payloads and headers. Observed that sequences > 800 tokens increase KV cache misses dramatically.

jamie: Noting correlation: heavy inputs + canary routing + autoscaler hiccup -> backlog -> upstream timeouts.

sara: Action items for postmortem (assignments):
- devon: root cause on autoscaler/image-pull + durable fix for HPA behavior (owner: devon)
- ryan: validate canary rollout gating + revert playbook improvements (owner: ryan)
- lina: kvcache telemetry + add alert to console (owner: lina)
- ops-bot: add automated runbook link to incident channel (owner: ops-bot)
- sara: draft incident summary for customers and internal retro (owner: sara)

sara: I'll take postmortem owner. Draft by EOD and retrospective tomorrow 11:00 UTC.

devon: Putting a short-term hotfix tag on the proxy timeout and bumping HPA min replicas for eu-west until autoscaler fix. Will open PR and link after tests.

jamie: Thanks all. Please add any other follow-ups here. If customers escalate, loop in support@redwood.

ops-bot: UPDATE: error rate returning toward baseline at 09:35 UTC. Monitoring for 30m window.

sara: Closing war-room thread for now — monitoring in channel. Postmortem tracking: https://pm.redwood/incidents/1712346789 (will update). :white_check_mark:
